text_block_list.text: Worried about Haru Urara not showing up for training, I went looking for her...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Today, I went to a shopping district party~!
Can you guess why~?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The answer is, they invited me
"as a thank-you for always cheering them up"!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Even though I'm the one who gets energized by yummy sweets and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
When I heard there were tons of sweets,
I completely forgot about everything else!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: Be more careful next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! From now on, I'll definitely,
defiiiinitely be careful!
